what: Exit-2 contract and logging disagree on stdout vs stderr under lib-quiet
scenario_or_breakage: `append-tool-failure.sh` logs a capture file; Failure mode 1 says append stderr only, while `emit_kv` contract lines go to FD3 (caller stdout). Tests say PLAN_SIZE_STATUS on stderr/stdout, so harness and operators cannot rely on one stream.
suggested_fix: Specify exit-2 emits `PLAN_SIZE_STATUS` via `emit_kv` on the contract stream (FD3) before exit 2, and require Step 2b.5 to log a single combined stdout+stderr capture (or stdout-only if status is always emit_kv); delete stderr/stdout ambiguity in test cases 9-10.

what: SKILL Step 2b.5 parse list omits failure-path fields needed for the warning template
scenario_or_breakage: Bullet 1 lists only happy-path KV keys; Failure mode 1 needs `<status>` from `PLAN_SIZE_STATUS` (and optionally partial KV) when exit ne 0.
suggested_fix: Orchestrator cannot implement the cited user-visible line without an explicit parse/fallback rule (e.g., parse `PLAN_SIZE_STATUS=` from the same stdout capture on any exit, then branch).

what: PLAN_LINES definition conflicts with the multiple-diff_lines edge case
scenario_or_breakage: Body count says trim the trailing `diff_lines:` line singular while DIFF_LINES uses the last `^diff_lines: [0-9]+$` match; a non-trailer earlier match yields inconsistent PLAN_LINES vs DIFF_LINES.
suggested_fix: Define PLAN_LINES as line count after removing the chosen DIFF_LINES line only, or removing every `^diff_lines: [0-9]+$` line, or require matching emit-plan body semantics; align Edge cases with the same rule.

what: Helper diff-line selection can diverge from emit-plan after EMIT_PLAN
scenario_or_breakage: emit-plan uses last non-empty line awk; proposed helper uses last regex match; if a valid earlier `diff_lines:` exists and the final non-empty line is not a trailer, emit fails but check-plan-size could still parse a number.
suggested_fix: Reuse the same awk tail selection as emit-plan.sh for the happy path, or normatively state check-plan-size runs only after successful EMIT_PLAN and therefore must mirror emit-plan exactly; document the abnormal-path behavior.

what: TRIGGER_REASONS multi-hit ordering is required by tests but omitted from the helper KV contract bullet
scenario_or_breakage: Harness case 5 expects lexicographic token order; NEW script section lists tokens only.
suggested_fix: Specify deterministic ordering (lexicographic on token names) in the helper spec, flags.md, and check-plan-size.md so implementer and harness cannot drift.

what: flags.md bullet documents exit 2 but not PLAN_SIZE_STATUS values
scenario_or_breakage: `references/flags.md` update lists exit 2 generically while the script section names `missing-plan` and `missing-diff-lines`.
suggested_fix: Extend the flags.md helper contract with the exact `PLAN_SIZE_STATUS` token set and that they accompany exit 2, matching check-plan-size.md.
